page0.text:
"...Ngh!?"
I wake up to a searing pain in my chest.
It feels like I've just had a bad dream.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page0:1

page1.text:
"Wh-why...does my chest hurt?"
My heart feels like it's burning.
Actually, it feels more heat from outside has been forced into my body.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page1:1

page2.text:
"...From outside!?"
I doubt myself briefly.
But before I can think of what it might be, I find myself rushing outside.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page2:1

page3.text:
"Saber, are you here!?"
I open the sliding screen door to Saber's room.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page3:1

page4.text:
"She's not here. Don't tell me she..."
No, there's no doubt.
If she's not here, she...went to Ryudou Temple on her own!
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page4:1

page5.text: "That idiot! Why!? She hasn't healed, so why would she...!?"
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page5:1

page6.text:
I'm so angry my head is starting to hurt.
I didn't tell her I wasn't going to fight.
I just...
I just didn't want her to get hurt like that again!
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page6:1

page7.text:
"Gngh...!"
There's no point in fuming here.
I need to hurry to Ryudou Temple.
I can't let Saber fight alone.
Well I don't know what good I can do her, but if I get there, maybe I can do something!
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page7:1

page8.text:
"Argh! She's a girl! Why can't she just behave herself!?"
I run.
I don't even take the time to change. Out front, I grab a bike and pedal as fast as I can.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-09:page8:1
